beats.speaker: q
beats.text: Why did a painter put himself in a portrait of the royal family?

beats.speaker: a
beats.text: That painter was Diego Velázquez, and the painting is Las Meninas. He painted the king for thirty-seven years.
beats.say: That painter was Diego Velasquez, and the painting is Las Meninas. He painted the king for thirty-seven years.

beats.speaker: q
beats.text: Where did he start?

beats.speaker: a
beats.text: He was born in Seville in 1599. As a young man he painted the street: cooks, beggars, a water seller.

beats.speaker: q
beats.text: How big was Spain then?

beats.speaker: a
beats.text: Still enormous: Spain and Portugal, much of Italy, the southern Netherlands, and the Americas.

beats.speaker: a
beats.text: At twenty-four, Velázquez got one sitting with the young king, Philip the Fourth. The king was thrilled.
beats.say: At twenty-four, Velasquez got one sitting with the young king, Philip the Fourth. The king was thrilled.

beats.speaker: a
beats.text: He became court painter, with a promise: no one else would ever paint the king.

beats.speaker: q
beats.text: What did he paint for the king?

beats.speaker: a
beats.text: Spain's victories, like Breda. The winner doesn't humiliate the loser. He puts a hand on his shoulder.

beats.speaker: a
beats.text: But the wars drained the treasury. In 1640, Catalonia and Portugal rose up. Portugal was gone for good.

beats.speaker: a
beats.text: In Rome he painted the Pope so honestly that, the story goes, the Pope said: too true.

beats.speaker: q
beats.text: And Las Meninas?

beats.speaker: a
beats.text: A little princess, her maids, a dwarf, a sleepy dog. In the mirror at the back: the king and queen, as if they stood right where you are.

beats.speaker: a
beats.text: And on the left, brush in hand, Velázquez himself, with a red cross of knighthood on his chest.
beats.say: And on the left, brush in hand, Velasquez himself, with a red cross of knighthood on his chest.

beats.speaker: q
beats.text: Was he really a knight?

beats.speaker: a
beats.text: Not yet. He was only made a knight in 1659, three years later. Someone painted the cross in afterwards. He died the next summer, as Spain's empire was fading.

beats.speaker: a
beats.text: Next time: the dying king whose will started a world war. Like the video and follow History Sketches.

beats.speaker: q
beats.text: And tell us in the comments what you think!
